inlines.v: UNCON'QUERABLE, adjective 1. Not conquerable; invincible; that cannot be vanquished or defeated; that cannot be overcome in contest; as an unconquerable for. 2. That cannot be subdued and brought under control; as unconquerable passions or temper.
